title: Wayfare Bikes Access Annual: Qualifying Programs and Re-verification
content:
Wayfare Bikes Access Annual is the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan whose eligibility rests on program enrollment. Enrollment in one of the following programs qualifies for Access Annual:

- SNAP
- Medicaid
- LIHEAP
- public housing assistance
- community college aid

The same list of qualifying programs stands in the schedule of every Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan, from Pay As You Ride to Annual Plus; it is the list against which Access Annual eligibility is shown.

## Re-verification

Access eligibility must be shown again a set number of months after purchase. The figure is 12 months for Access Annual and 0 for every other plan.

| Plan | Programs whose enrollment qualifies for Access Annual | Months after purchase when Access eligibility must be shown again |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP, public housing assistance, community college aid | 0 |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP, public housing assistance, community college aid | 0 |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP, public housing assistance, community college aid | 0 |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP, public housing assistance, community college aid | 12 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP, public housing assistance, community college aid | 0 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | SNAP, Medicaid, LIHEAP, public housing assistance, community college aid | 0 |

## Eligibility points (hypothetical riders)

- A rider enrolled in Medicaid holds a qualifying enrollment for Access Annual; so does a rider receiving community college aid.
- A rider whose only program is not on the list does not hold a qualifying enrollment.
- An Access Annual plan bought on 5 February 2025 has its eligibility shown again 12 months after purchase, on 5 February 2026.
